title: Concept: Server-side fetch with a computed URL in go — review required
description: In go, net/http receives a URL that is not a literal. Go performs no egress filtering of its own, and the default transport follows redirects, so a value derived from a query parameter can reach loopback services, RFC 1918 hosts, or the cloud metadata address. The call site looks like ordinary code because the type is still a string.
applicability: go services that fetch user-supplied or configured URLs.
risk: Access to internal services and metadata endpoints; MEDIUM severity.
